Get an exclusive Ground & Drone Video Update of *Package-08 of the Raipur–Visakhapatnam Economic Corridor (NH-130CD)* in Odisha.
This package stretches approximately *22.533 KM from Kandili to Tumbigura* in Koraput District, Odisha. One of the major highlights of this section is the impressive *2.87 KM Twin Tunnel,* constructed through the challenging hilly terrain of the Eastern Ghats.
In this video, explore the latest construction progress and stunning aerial views of this magnificent infrastructure project.
• Project Highlights:*
• Project: Raipur–Visakhapatnam Economic Corridor
